title: Plan numbers must match accounts: Ready to Assign + available in categories = account balances (YNAB parity)
description: Owner report 2026-11-27 (budget Casa b35979ff-cce2-4226-9d70-bfc8b45bf1ec): Ready to Assign shows more money than exists in accounts (cash 60.596,73, RTA 76.070,88; hiding a category moved it to 75.545,89).
